about: One entry per self-improvement run (scripts: ops/improvement-playbook.md). status: watching -> helped | no clear effect | hurt | reverted; no-op runs are logged too.

entries.title: Added static A-Z link lists to companies.html and judges.html
entries.why: site_audit.py (ops/metrics/audit.json, 2026-10-09 snapshot) found 92 orphan root pages. 76 of them were the company-*.html and judge-*.html profile pages, which companies.html and judges.html only ever link to from JavaScript-built cards, invisible to site_audit and to any crawler that doesn't execute JS. This was backlog item 1, ranked top because it was the audit's largest single finding category.

verdict.note: Live site_audit.py run: orphanPages 92 -> 1 (98%+ drop); the one remaining orphan, judge-frank-volk.html, is a judge added to js/data.js after this change shipped, not a return of the original 92.

entries.title: Cleared the remaining 16 orphan root pages (state guides, author bio, newsletter, handbook redirect)
entries.why: site_audit.py (--print, re-run live this session) showed orphanPages still at 16 after imp-001: the 13 state-guide deep-dive pages, only linked from state-guides.html's JS-built state picker (same shape as imp-001's company/judge pages); author-jeff-novel.html and newsletter.html, with zero static inbound links anywhere on the site; and handbook.html, a pure client-side redirect stub to eviction-guide.html that a crawler would never follow in. This was backlog item 2.

verdict.note: Live site_audit.py run: all of imp-002's targets (state guides, author bio, newsletter, handbook) remain linked; the one orphan present today (a judge page) is outside this change's scope.

entries.title: Moved companies.html/judges.html A-Z lists into scripts/prerender.ts
entries.why: Judging imp-001/imp-002 today (live site_audit.py, since no fresh ops/metrics snapshot had landed) found orphanPages at 1: judge-frank-volk.html, added to js/data.js after imp-001's hand-written A-Z list was last updated. This confirms backlog item 0 (Jeff's session, 2026-10-09): the hand-written lists go stale whenever the digest adds a party or judge. Generated the lists in scripts/prerender.ts from RELAW_DATA.trackedParties and RELAW_DATA.judges instead, filtered to slugs whose profile page exists, between prerender:companies-az-list/judges-az-list markers (same pattern as featured-grid). Baked the current output by hand since deno is unavailable in this cloud session; the prerender workflow regenerates it on future pushes.

verdict.note: Live site_audit.py run: orphanPages 0 despite freshness.matters rising 232 -> 242 since imp-003 shipped, so the new judges/companies in that window linked themselves automatically instead of re-orphaning.

entries.title: Fixed dollar-figure text corrupting meta tags on matter/record pages
entries.why: audit.json's weakDescription list (10 pages) included 7 matter pages with implausibly short char counts (live-137: 2, live-203: 11). `grep -rl 'content="[^"]*<meta ' matters/ chapter-11/ federal-cases/` found 31 published pages where a second <meta name="description" content="..."> fragment was spliced into the first one's attribute value. Root cause: build_matter_pages.ts/build_record_pages.ts build title/description/OG/Twitter/canonical tags with .replace(regex, templateString) using a literal "$1" to reinsert the matched opening tag; "$1" is special to String.replace, so a summary containing a dollar figure like "$170M" has its digit read as a second backreference. This was backlog item 5's real cause, not thin content.

verdict.note: Confirmed same-day: the prerender workflow rebuilt all matter/record pages from the fixed builder (commit 0c21e23) within minutes of the push. Live site_audit.py: weakDescription 10 -> 3, and the 3 remaining are exactly the pages flagged as a separate, still-open issue (contact.html, handbook-success.html, reset-password.html), not this fix's targets. Judged now rather than at checkAfter since the result was already unambiguous.

entries.title: Wrote real meta descriptions for the 3 remaining weakDescription pages
entries.why: imp-004's verdict named contact.html (37 chars), handbook-success.html (65 chars) and reset-password.html (46 chars) as genuinely thin hand-written descriptions, separate from the builder bug -- backlog item 5's still-open remainder. contact.html is indexable (no noindex), so its thin description had real SEO/SERP-snippet impact; the other two are noindex but still read truncated/generic when shared or inspected. Replaced each with copy drawn from the page's own actual content (contact page's real pitch: evaluate the tracker for your team or flag a matter; handbook-success's real coverage: all 50 states + DC, access unlocked on the matching account; reset-password's real flow: new password saved, signed in automatically), 120-152 chars each, within site_audit.py's 70-320 char window.

entries.title: Added a "From the court record" block linking Chapter 11 Watch and Federal Lawsuit Watch from index.html and litigation.html
entries.why: Playbook backlog item 3: homepage and litigation.html linked Chapter 11 Watch (ops/ch11-petitions.json, 114 filings) and Federal Lawsuit Watch (ops/federal-suits.json, 59 filings) only from the nav dropdown, never on the page itself, even though both feed real record pages at chapter-11/<slug>.html and federal-cases/<slug>.html. Audit was otherwise clean this run (brokenLinks/orphanPages/weakDescription all 0; the 2 remaining missingDescription pages are both already noindex), so this was the top open backlog item.
